content:
Joining Amazon's early fall Prime Day deals, plus today's $500 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal, 9to5Toys' Lunch Break headlines feature iPhone 17 Pro Max models at up to $513 less than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium). We also have ecobee's official early fall Prime Day HomeKit deals starting today, with up to $210 off smart thermostats, bundles, and more, plus a range of Apple accessory discounts: Solo Loop bands from $7 or less, a rare $100 off Apple Magic Keyboard Folio, and 40% off the official MagSafe Battery. There are also plenty of chargers, TVs, smart speakers and more deals waiting for you.

Amazon is currently selling iPhone 17 Pro Max models for up to $513 less than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium)

We've found opportunities to buy iPhone 17 Pro deals directly from Amazon many times before, but this is the first time we've seen significant discounts on unlocked Renewed Premium models, coinciding with early fall Prime Day deals. The iPhone 18 Pro Max is already out, but right now you can get a similarly specced 17 Pro for over $500 less. Details below.

1TB iPhone 17 Pro Max now from $1,385.78 with free shipping. That's $213 less than the original price of this model brand new, and up to $513 less than Apple's 1TB 18 Pro Max.

Apple launched the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max this month at $1,899, and while the 1TB 17 Pro Max didn't launch at quite that price, prices have crept up, and now thanks to Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed listings, you can get a substantial discount.

Only the Deep Blue model has been marked down this low directly from Amazon, other models are still well below the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max price:

  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Cosmic Orange (Renewed): $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Deep Blue (Renewed): $1,386 (originally $1,599)

Apple's refurbished store still doesn't sell iPhone 17 series devices, what we're looking at here are the highest quality units sold by Amazon, backed by a full 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and "battery life exceeding 90% of original capacity" — these aren't your typical refurbished units.

Here's how much iPhone 17 Pro is going for right now at Amazon Renewed Premium:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 brand new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 brand new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 brand new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 brand new)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro now $500 off at Amazon, available in Silver and Space Black

The latest M5 MacBook Air still has some notable deals that are even cheaper, but we want to circle back to this $500 off 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal Amazon is offering — both Space Black and Silver models are now available at heavily discounted deal prices.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This price matches the lowest we've tracked over the past few months, but now both the Space Black and Silver versions are in stock — the latter doesn't usually go on sale that often.

Apple Solo Loops clearance sale now live: 1 for $7, 2 for $10, 3 for $15 (originally $49+ each)

To coincide with early fall Prime Day deals, Woot has just launched a full clearance sale on official Apple Braided Solo Loops and Apple Watch Solo Loop bands. Each band is now just $6.99 with Prime shipping, and you can take an extra 30% off at checkout when buying "2 or more".

We've seen plenty of Apple Solo Loop deals over the past year, but never prices this low. We expect color and size selections to start selling out fast — if you see one you like at this price, grab it now.

Solo Loops normally retail for $49, so even buying just one is a great deal. But buying 2 or more gets you an additional 30% off, making it an absolute steal:

  • Apple Solo Loop $7 (originally $49+)
  • 2-pack Apple Solo Loop $10 (originally $98+)
  • 3-pack Apple Solo Loop $15 (originally $147+)

Color and size selections are already starting to sell out — we won't say more, grab them while supplies last.

Rare $100 discount on Amazon's Apple iPad Magic Keyboard Folio

ecobee's official early fall Prime Day HomeKit deals start today: smart thermostats, bundles and more from $210 off

While we're still in early fall Prime Day mode with tens of thousands of deals to grab, ecobee has informed 9to5Toys that their official Prime Big Deal Days promotions actually start today. From now through October 7, discounts of over $200 are available across the brand's popular HomeKit smart thermostat lineup and bundles.

ecobee's official early fall Prime Day deals start today

Although the product pages for these deals don't yet have official Prime Day labels, the prices already reflect official early fall Prime Day discounts, many matching what we tracked during the summer Prime Day event. Outside of major seasonal sales, this brand rarely sees prices this low with this many options discounted — if you're looking to upgrade your smart home, now is the time to grab a great deal.

  • Smart Thermostat Premium $210 (originally $260)
  • Smart Thermostat Enhanced $165 (originally $200)
  • Smart Thermostat Essential $110 (originally $140)
  • Smart Doorbell Camera $120 (originally $160)
  • SmartSensor for Rooms (2-pack) $75 (originally $100)
  • SmartSensor for Doors & Windows $50 (originally $80)

Full bundle discounts:

Nearly all full bundles are now priced the same as or lower than what we tracked during the official summer Prime Day event.

  • Total Security and Savings Bundle $370 (originally $500) Smart Doorbell Camera (Wired), SmartSensor for Doors and Windows, and Smart Thermostat Premium
  • Total Security Bundle 1-Year Smart Security Advanced $375 (originally $580) Smart Thermostat Premium, Smart Doorbell Camera, SmartSensors, and 1-year Smart Security Advanced
  • Comfort and Security Bundle $245 (originally $340) Smart Thermostat Premium, Smart Sensor, SmartSensor for Doors and Windows 2-pack

Twelve South dual USB-C wall charger with Find My drops to $37 (47% off launch price)

Spigen Wrist Lanyard Strap magnetic version drops to $15 with Prime shipping

Amazon's all-new Fire TV Stick 4K arrives today at 50% off, more from $16

To coincide with the ongoing early fall Prime Day deals, Amazon today launched the all-new Fire TV Stick 4K, and you can use promo code 4KINTRO at checkout to get a solid 50% off. This major launch deal also folds in early fall Prime Day discounts on the Fire TV Stick and other streaming device lineup, starting from $16.

Fire TV Stick early fall Prime Day deals:

  • All-new Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K: $30 (originally $60)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick HD: $16 (originally $40)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Wi-Fi 6E: $45 (originally $85)
  • Amazon Fire TV Cube, 4K Ultra HD, Wi-Fi 6E: $90 (originally $140+)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Plus, Wi-Fi 6: $38 (originally $70)
  • Amazon Fire TV Alexa Voice Remote Pro: $20 (originally $35)

Amazon is currently selling the all-new Fire TV Stick 4K with upgraded Fire TV Remote for $29.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

You'll need to click the coupon on the page or use promo code 4KINTRO at checkout.

Best-value 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now $100 off, 24GB models $150 off

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Today's Baseus smart display charger is just $43 and comes with a free 100W braided USB-C cable
  • This 12-in-1 Baseus dock elevates your laptop and expands to a full workstation's worth of ports, now just $42
  • Spacious 55-inch PU leather desk mat drops to $26 with Prime shipping
  • Samsung 2026 4K/5K ViewFinity Mac-ready workstation monitors at nearly 60% off for early fall Prime Day
  • Bring home the roborock 2026 flagship Qrevo Edge 3 Pro robot vacuum and mop at a new low of $1,100, more from $160
  • Add six smart bulbs to your Apple Home for just $5 each (30% off)
  • Anker iPhone charger with built-in foldable stand now just $26 (nearly 50% off)
  • Brand-new Baseus braided USB-C cables to match your iPhone 18 Pro, from $10

Amazon just announced a ton of upcoming early fall Prime Day deals

All-new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals back at Amazon (up to $50 off)

Alongside this morning's $500 off 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal, Amazon has also brought back all launch deals for the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio.

Both the 2026 Mac mini with the all-new M6 chip and the higher-end M5 Pro models sold by Amazon have dropped back to all-time low prices:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (originally $1,699)

The all-new Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and 512GB built-in storage is also $50 off:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,449 (originally $2,499)

While these aren't massive discounts, for early adopters this is Amazon's current lowest price, and all configurations sold by Amazon have dropped back to all-time lows — we want to make sure everyone catches these deals as we kick off a new work week.
